Five investigators concept lineup sheet

Five-character concept lineup, 1930s coastal-noir style, muted teal-and-brass palette (deep-teal base #0d1f23, brass #dcae55, sea-glass teal #6fb8af, rust-red #c95d43 accents). Characters left to right: retired navy captain in weathered trench coat with peaked cap holding a revolver; hooded folklore scholar with a rune staff; bounty hunter with wide-brim hat and sawed-off shotgun on back; field physician in short cape carrying a medical case; blasting engineer with welding mask pushed up and nail-gun on hip. Full-body silhouettes plus 3/4-view color versions, single row, fog beach backdrop, low pale moon. Painterly, grain texture, no text.
